final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.SupportRepId AS rep_id, e.City AS city, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.City), step2 AS (SELECT city, AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM step1 GROUP BY city), step3 AS (SELECT s1.rep_id, s1.city, s1.record_count, s1.record_count - s2.avg_count AS difference FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.city = s2.city WHERE s1.record_count > s2.avg_count), step4 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.rep_id, s3.city, s3.record_count, s3.difference, 1.0 * s3.record_count / s4.total_count AS ratio FROM step3 s3 JOIN step4 s4 ON s4.total_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT city, SUM(record_count), AVG(difference), AVG(ratio) FROM step5 GROUP BY city
